llm_summary_material: Black holes span >8 orders of magnitude: stellar-mass ones run 3–100 M☉ from collapsed stars, while supermassive ones reach billions at galactic centres (Sagittarius A* ≈ 4.3 M☉×10⁶).
Event Horizon Telescope imaging confirmed theory: M87's shadow (April 2019, ~6.5 billion M☉) then Sgr A* (2022) — direct interferometry beats inference from indirect signatures.
Hawking radiation is physically real but operationally irrelevant: a solar-mass hole evaporates in ~10⁶⁷ years, far exceeding the universe's age.
Process coffee cherries within hours of picking: washed = mechanical depulp plus 12–72 h mucilage ferment, highlighting acidity and floral notes (Colombia, most of Central America).
Natural (dry) processing sun-dries whole cherries 2–4 weeks for wine-like Ethiopian/Brazilian cup, but uneven drying causes off-flavours; honey grades (yellow/red/black) map to retained mucilage.
Finish drying to ~11% moisture then hull, size/density grade and rest; medium roast is reached at ~205–215 °C just after first crack.

EV practice: Li-ion at ~250 Wh/kg and 800 V architectures (Ioniq 5, Taycan) add 200 km in ~15 min DC fast charging, while pack cost fell from ~$1,100/kWh (2010) to <$140 (2023) and solid-state targets ~2027 production.
Internet milestones anchored the open web: TCP/IP "flag day" 1 Jan 1983, DNS (Mockapetris) same year, WWW at CERN 1989 / public 1991, commercial restrictions lifted 1995 → 5.4 billion users by 2023.
